episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Marissa and Peter Irvine enter every parent's worst nightmare when their young son, Milo, is kidnapped after a playdate with a boy at his new school.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A press conference intended to help find Milo implodes and the Irvines are scrutinized.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A canvassing event aims to keep the case alive; Peter takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: While struggling to locate Milo, Alcaras is tempted by an offer that goes against his morals.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: News from Alcaras throws suspicion on the whole family as a secret threatens to tear them apart.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The Irvines struggle to adjust to their new normal as Jenny makes some discoveries of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Carrie's obsession grows as she plans Milo's kidnapping, but is left reeling as things implode.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Learning about Carrie's past, the truth dawns on Marissa before deciding how to protect her family.
